lines.caption: This is a tour of pull request 94, which keeps free space and folder totals in the status bar and drops the byte counts.
lines.say: This is a tour of pull request ninety-four, which keeps free space and folder totals in the status bar and drops the byte counts.

lines.caption: It has three parts: what this PR adds, how it was built and verified, and what comes later.
Part 1. What this PR adds.
Total and Free space now stay in the status bar when something is selected, and a search shows its size and free space.
A folder loads or you select files, and any status bar job still running is cancelled.
Thunar picks the case: nothing selected, one file, or several files.
A background job counts the folder, then adds Total and Free space.
The job writes the status bar only if it wasn't cancelled, under the same lock as the cancel.
When a search starts, the free space of its root folder is asked once, without blocking.
The result count gains the results' size, summed from files already loaded.
Count and free space are joined, with no Total while searching.
Before, selecting a file or searching hid the free space and the folder's counts, and sizes carried exact byte counts.
Free space can take seconds on a slow network drive, so it never blocks the window: it always comes from the background.
Step 1: the update first cancels the old job, holding the status bar text lock.
Step 2: one selected file shows its name, size and type at once; a job adds the rest.
Step 3: one job now replaces the old folder and selection jobs, and adds Total and Free space.
Step 4: because cancel and write share a lock, a slow job can't paste its Total onto newer text.
Step 5: the search's free space query is cancelled when the search ends or the view closes.
Step 6: three files found becomes three files found, six mebibytes, with no disk read.
Step 7: a selection made during a search keeps the same free space text.
With nothing selected, the text stays the same, minus the byte count.
With one file or several selected, Total and Free space now follow the selection's own part.
While searching, the count gains a size and the free space.
Where a location doesn't report free space, like the trash, that part is still left out.
The counting is split from the formatting, so one count gives either the folder text or the Total part.
Size, Total and Free space each come from one helper, used by the job and by the search.
Size in bytes leaves the default; the status bar's right-click toggle still brings it back.
The PR changes seven files in the thunar folder, adds the test script, and this page with its narration.
To get byte counts back, tick Size in bytes; if you set the setting before, the new default won't apply.
Part 2. How it was built and verified.
It was checked against the issue's table, main's status bar job, and the Size in bytes toggle.
The package built in this session's cloud container, with no compiler warnings in the changed files.
All ten tests passed against this build: the smoke test and nine verify scripts, on the test script as it was then.
Test 74 passed in 53 seconds; it selects rows from a known cursor place, and checks Thunar keeps running.
lines.say: Test seventy-four passed in fifty-three seconds; it selects rows from a known cursor place, and checks Thunar keeps running.

lines.caption: An earlier run failed on the test's shot names; they were renamed.
A second run passed, but its shot audit found rows selected one off; the test now selects from a known place.
On that run, the shot auditor read every status bar and passed all ten shots and three pairs.
It wasn't run in your own session.
CI's shot audit failed once: the trash shot's text was cut off at the window edge. The test was fixed to show less.
The code and the test changed after this local run; CI's verify runs on the final code.
A fresh agent reviewed the diff and found five things: three fixed, two kept as the issue asks.
The medium one: a cancelled job leaked a reference to the view. The job no longer takes that extra reference.
Two low ones reworded shot captions.
Kept: Total recounts the folder in the background, and the search size reads sizes already loaded.
CI's own review, at level high, found nine things on PR 94.
lines.say: CI's own review, at level high, found nine things on PR ninety-four.

lines.caption: CI's own fix commit fixed three, including a medium one: the search's free space kept old units after a setting change.
This session fixed two more: the Total count now stops when its job is cancelled.
Later reviews found three more, all fixed, including a trash shot that could run off the screen.
You accepted five, one by one, such as the search's own free space lookup, which the issue asks for.
The rest were unconfirmed low findings from later reviews, accepted under the review rules.
CI's build and tests on the final code, and the audit of CI's shots of the final head, are still pending.
Your own folders and drives can only be checked on your machine, after the merge.
The links lead to the issue, the PR and its checks, and the shots.
Part 3. What comes later: nothing depends on 74.
lines.say: Part 3. What comes later: nothing depends on seventy-four.

lines.caption: No open issue builds on this one; what remains is trying it yourself.
After the merge, select one file, then several, then search, and look for Total and Free space.
In short: the status bar keeps the folder's totals and free space in view, without byte counts.
